description: Off by one when counting gaps, floors or saw cuts.
advice: Before answering, draw a quick sketch: the posts as dots and the gaps between them, then count both.

description: Missed an option while enumerating: a case left out, or a shorter way than the one found.
advice: List the cases in a fixed order, smallest first, and tick each one off so that none is left out.

description: Counted the same option twice.
advice: Write each option down once, in a fixed order, and look for repeats before counting them.

description: Did not notice the word "not" in the question.
advice: Read the question aloud and circle the word "not" before solving it.

description: Answered a different question: asked how many are left, answered how many were taken.
advice: Before answering, say in your own words what the question asks for, and check the answer against it.

description: Stopped at an intermediate result instead of finishing the solution.
advice: After each step, ask whether that is what the question wants, or only a step towards it.

description: Used the wrong operation: added instead of subtracting, multiplied instead of dividing.
advice: Act the story out with small objects or a drawing to see whether things are added, taken away or shared.

description: Reversed a comparison: taller and shorter, before and after, more and less.
advice: Draw the comparison as a line from the smallest to the largest before reading off the answer.

description: Counted the lucky case instead of the worst case when the answer must be certain.
advice: Ask what the unluckiest possible way would be, and make sure the answer holds even then.

description: Took a statement as true without checking whether the speaker may be lying.
advice: For each speaker, try both: what follows if they tell the truth, and what follows if they lie.

description: Mixed up hours and minutes, or counted 100 minutes in an hour.
advice: Draw a clock face and count on in minutes, remembering that an hour has 60 of them, not 100.

description: Answered with a number from the question without computing anything.
advice: Before writing a number down, say which calculation it comes from: a number copied from the question is rarely the answer.

description: Got the parity wrong, for example thought that odd plus odd is odd.
advice: Check parity on small numbers first, such as 1 + 3 and 3 + 5, then say the rule out loud.

description: Ignored one of the conditions, such as "different", "exactly once" or "at both ends".
advice: Reread the question and mark every condition, such as "different" or "exactly once", then check the answer against each.

description: Took the percentage of the wrong quantity: of the new price instead of the old one.
advice: Ask first: a percentage of what? Write that whole amount down before taking the percentage.

description: Swapped the part and the whole, either way: answered with one when the other was asked for, or took a fraction of one as if it were a fraction of the other; a percentage of the wrong quantity is percent_wrong_base instead.
advice: Draw the whole as a bar and shade the part, then check which of the two the question asks for.

description: Treated a share of a ratio as a share of the total, or added the parts of the ratio wrongly.
advice: Draw the ratio as equal boxes, count all the boxes for the total, then work out what one box holds.

description: Gave the quotient where the remainder was asked for, or the other way round.
advice: Share real objects into groups, then say aloud which number is the groups and which is what is left over.

description: Counted the perimeter where the area was asked for, or the other way round.
advice: Trace the edge with a finger for the perimeter and colour the inside for the area, then reread which one is asked for.

description: Assumed that whoever moves first always wins, without checking the position.
advice: Play the game a few times from small positions and see who wins each one before deciding.
